conservative.requirements: 3 power, play after successfully casting a Jade Order spell. If you successfully cast a Jade Order spell, spend 3 power and place 6 recharge tokens on this card to choose an ally within medium range. That character recovers 1 wound. If you have Mastery of Spellcraft, that character recovers 1 additional wound.
conservative.name: LifeBloom

reckless.requirements: 3 power, play after successfully casting a Jade Order spell. If the spell was a Spring or Summer spell, you recover 1 wound. Effect: After you successfully cast a Jade Order spell, spend 3 power and place 6 recharge tokens on this card to choose an ally within medium range or yourself. That character recovers 1 wound. If you have Mastery of Spellcraft, that character recovers 1 additional wound.
